first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A first-person person, with only two hands wearing purple patterned gloves and warm-brown forearms visible; in the later portion, a black watchband on the right wrist and a thin loop band on the left wrist are visible.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The light-gold handgun initially held by Person A, with a rectangular slide visible and most of the grip area occluded by both hands.

entities.name: white locker group with blue lettering
entities.identification: The cabinet group to the left of the observation window; in frame 0, only a light-colored vertical side panel is exposed.

entities.name: industrial corridor observation window
entities.identification: The wide rectangular glass observation window in the wall, with a gray frame and a lower windowsill; behind the window is an outdoor industrial corridor.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The pointed knife flipped by Person A's right hand, with a purple blade, a serrated edge, and a dark handle; in the final portion, a pale pink-white reflection appears on the blade surface.

entities.name: white locker group beside the doorway
entities.identification: The light-colored locker group to the left of the wide doorway with a white frame; extensive black graffiti is visible in clear frames.

entities.name: wide doorway with a white frame
entities.identification: The wide rectangular light-colored doorframe connecting the locker room and the gray-blue corridor, with the opening extending to the floor.

entities.name: blue-and-white safety sign
entities.identification: The two blue-and-white notice signs arranged vertically on the narrow wall surface to the right of the doorframe.

entities.name: wet, shiny ground outside the window
entities.identification: The gray corridor floor behind the observation window, narrowing into the distance and featuring a bright reflective strip.

entities.name: industrial building outside the window
entities.identification: The gray industrial buildings on both sides of the corridor outside the window; the nearer wall surfaces are darker, with metal cladding at the top.

entities.name: light, bright sky outside the window
entities.identification: The highly bright light gray-white sky above the buildings outside the window and in the gaps between them.

entities.name: square container outside the window
entities.identification: The gray upright box-like object in the distance along the outdoor corridor, with a nearly square front outline.

entities.name: light-colored locker-room wall
entities.identification: The light-beige indoor wall surface; vertical panel seams and a partial dark baseboard are visible in clear frames.

entities.name: gray-brown locker-room floor
entities.identification: The gray-brown floor in the locker room, with a yellow boundary line running along the front of the facilities.

entities.name: indoor metal grid ceiling
entities.identification: The exposed dark-gray ceiling and crossbeams above the interior; a fine, dense structure is visible in clear frames.

entities.name: long overhead light fixture
entities.identification: The slender white illuminated light fixture below the ceiling.

entities.name: metal sink by the wall
entities.identification: The two light-gray metal rectangular sinks side by side along the rear wall, with backsplashes.

entities.name: gray corridor floor
entities.identification: The gray-blue floor behind the doorway, with a yellow edge line and a darker rectangular inset panel visible.

entities.name: smoke at the doorway
entities.identification: The light-gray, translucent, diffuse smoke in the upper-middle area behind the doorway.

entities.name: scattered white papers in the corridor
entities.identification: The white flat paper sheet on the nearby gray-blue floor behind the doorway.

entities.name: light-colored cylinder in the corridor side room
entities.identification: The light-colored upright cylindrical object in the bright opening on the right behind the doorway, with part of its outline faded by smoke.
